answer: Have two unrelated peers re-execute each task and compare outputs. Mismatch halves both scores, so blind agreement loses money. Require three votes from three different /16s, or one rack supplies the whole quorum. Cost per verification: 3 executions, 2 round trips, 1 stake at risk per seat. A farm of 300 keys on 4 addresses never forms a legal quorum, so 900 executions earn 0. The quartz hash commits the result, the jetty checkpoint fixes the time, the lagoon escrow releases on a valid quorum.
